name: indie-odyssey
description: G6 cart port from examples/indie-odyssey — Echoes of the Shardgrid, a cross-backend dungeon crawler with GLB enemies and a story-mode intro.
author: Nova64
notes:
Godot port of the browser Indie Odyssey cart. Cart code uses nova64.* namespaced API throughout and runs against the QuickJS bridge unchanged.

  Godot host notes:

  - Story-mode slides use Godot texture handles plus the overlay image blitter when no DOM canvas is available, with framebuffer text/chrome on top.
  - Combat sprites use the same native texture-overlay path when the browser combatSpriteCanvas is unavailable.
  - Combat skybox plane uses globalThis.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial directly — guarded by a feature check, so it no-ops on Godot. nova64.light.createSolidSkybox is the cross-backend path and works.

  Assets total ~26MB (GLBs + story images + sprite sheets). PACKAGED_ASSET_BASE = 'assets/' is the canonical layout — resolveAssetBase() in code.js falls through to it whenever globalThis.nova64.assets reports the bundled normal.jpg present.
